Package es.uib.lotery.packet

Interface BasePacket

All Known Implementing Classes:
DNSConnectPacket, DNSRequestPacket, DNSResponsePacket, SorteoRequestPacket, SorteoResponsePacket
public interface BasePacket
Represents a generic packet for the lottery system.

All packet types must implement this interface to provide serialization and deserialization logic using ByteBuffer.

Typical usage:


 BasePacket packet = new SorteoRequestPacket(...);
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(256);
 packet.encode(buffer);
 buffer.flip();
 BasePacket decoded = packet.decode(buffer);
